tasks.short: Turn the Finance Director's budget instructions into clear planning rules for Rotterdam, Tilburg and Venlo.

today.trigger: The Finance Director issues budget instructions or changes assumptions during a forecast round.
steps: Read the instructions, previous budget guidance and relevant SharePoint policies.
Compare the instructions with AFAS cost centres, existing Excel models and site practices.
Clarify targets, labour assumptions, spending limits and exceptions with Finance, HR and site managers.
Draft planning rules, submission templates and worked examples.
Obtain approval and explain the rules to budget owners.
drudgery: Finding the latest instruction among email threads and document versions.
Repeating the same rule in guidance, spreadsheets and presentations.
Checking whether all three sites use the same assumptions.
today.time_sinks: Clarifying ambiguous instructions and reconciling conflicting versions; approval and site discussions remain necessary.

lenses.faster: AI compares the new instructions with the approved rules and drafts a change list, guidance and examples. Searching documents and rewriting the same instruction across templates largely disappear.
lenses.autonomous: A new instruction in a designated SharePoint folder starts document comparison and prepares a review pack. Ambiguities remain open questions until the analyst resolves them.
lenses.ambitious: Maintain one planning rulebook with owners, effective dates and examples for each site. Check every forecast submission against it before consolidation.
lenses.joy: Remove version chasing and repetitive formatting. Keep the conversations that turn an unrealistic target into a workable plan.
lenses.options: Show alternative treatments for uncertain volume, agency rates and overtime, with their forecast effects. The analyst can explain the trade-offs before choosing a rule.
lenses.altitude: Own the planning rules and their checks rather than rewriting guidance each round. Track which rules cause repeated questions or forecast errors.
reach: Prepare the Controller's checks for consistent planning assumptions.
Maintain labour-cost planning assumptions with Payroll and Compensation and Benefits.
Prepare budget-owner briefings for the Finance Director.

tasks.human_edge: Resolve what management actually intends, challenge conflicting targets and judge whether a rule is workable on shifts. Finance and HR retain authority over policy, CAO interpretation and employment implications.
tasks.pattern_why: Copilot is the main pattern because interpreting directives requires judgment and agreement. An llm_step can extract proposed rules from documents, while deterministic_software checks approved assumptions in templates.

in_practice.trigger: The Finance Director places a new or revised instruction in the agreed SharePoint folder.
steps: Retrieve the instruction and approved rulebook, preserving document versions and access permissions.
Draft a source-linked table of proposed rules, changed assumptions, affected sites and unresolved questions.
Check approved numeric rules against Excel templates and AFAS cost-centre mappings using deterministic checks.
Prepare guidance and worked examples; require the analyst to resolve ambiguities with Finance and HR.
After approval, publish the guidance and record the rule versions used in subsequent forecast submissions.
in_practice.human_gate: The analyst reviews every proposed rule; the Finance Director approves the guidance. HR validates labour assumptions against CAO Beroepsgoederenvervoer and the warehouse CAO, and assesses any required OR involvement.
systems: Approved LLM service and document workflow, proposed additions
data_needed: Current directives and approved prior guidance.
Planning assumptions with owners and effective dates.
HR-approved CAO cost rules and agency-rate assumptions.
in_practice.logs_to: A restricted SharePoint planning register containing source versions, proposed changes, resolved questions, approvals and published guidance.

evidence.claim: AFAS GetConnectors can retrieve administrator-defined records and fields, supporting controlled extraction of planning reference data.
An LLM can plausibly draft a comparison of directives and guidance, but completeness and interpretation require human review.
The current workflow is reconstructed from the company context. The 40% human-effort saving and 1.5-times end-to-end speedup are pilot hypotheses, allowing for approval delays.

risks: The draft turns an ambiguous instruction into a confident rule or cites an outdated document.
Different effective dates for CAO rules and agency rates produce inconsistent labour forecasts.

A budget rule is treated as authority to change employment arrangements; relevant changes require assessment of OR rights. [SER guidance on OR rights](https://www.ser.nl/nl/thema/medezeggenschap/faq/adviesrecht)
Sensitive payroll or commercial information reaches users who cannot access the underlying sources.
research_questions: Across the last three planning rounds, how much analyst time went into document comparison and drafting versus interpretation and agreement?
Can all authoritative directives and assumptions be identified by owner, version and effective date?
On historical instructions, does the draft capture every material change without inventing rules or missing site exceptions?
Does a pilot reduce total review effort and completion time while reducing inconsistent forecast submissions?

tasks.short: Compare investment, operating and financing choices with a cost model the business can challenge.

today.trigger: A site or Finance requests an appraisal of equipment, outsourcing, an operating change or financing alternatives.
steps: Collect the request, supplier quotes, operating assumptions and financing terms.
Extract historical costs from AFAS and agency portals and reconcile the relevant totals.
Build an Excel model of incremental cash flows, payback and discounted returns.
Test volume, labour, implementation and financing assumptions.
Discuss operational risks and present a recommendation for approval.
systems: Rabobank statements and supplied financing terms
drudgery: Copying prices and contract terms from quotes into spreadsheets.
Rebuilding similar appraisal models for each request.
Checking formula ranges, units and scenario versions.
today.time_sinks: Obtaining credible operating assumptions and comparable quotes; reconciling agency costs and checking whether claimed savings release cash.

lenses.faster: A standard model imports reconciled costs and calculates approved appraisal measures automatically. AI extracts quote terms into a review table and drafts the comparison from calculated results.
lenses.autonomous: A complete request starts data gathering, validation, scenario calculations and preparation of an appraisal pack. Missing terms or failed checks stop the workflow and go to the analyst.
lenses.ambitious: Appraise smaller recurring requests and revisit approved investments after implementation. Compare promised benefits with actual costs and use the differences to improve future assumptions.
lenses.joy: Remove quote transcription and repeated spreadsheet construction. Keep challenging weak assumptions and helping site managers choose a workable investment.
lenses.options: Compare doing nothing, repair, purchase, lease and outsourcing where relevant. Show downside, base and upside cases using consistent service and capacity assumptions.
lenses.altitude: Own a tested appraisal framework and the quality of its assumptions. Review exceptions and benefit delivery instead of rebuilding each calculation.
reach: Prepare capital-request packs for the Controller and Finance Director.
Compare supplier costs with the accounts payable Bookkeeper.
Prepare financing sensitivities and cash-demand schedules for the Finance Director.

tasks.human_edge: Judge whether productivity gains are achievable, whether released hours become cash savings and whether service or safety will suffer. The Finance Director retains investment and financing authority.
tasks.pattern_why: Agent_with_gate fits the multi-step collection and appraisal workflow. An llm_step extracts unstructured quote terms; deterministic_software performs financial calculations, and a person approves assumptions and the recommendation before it counts.

in_practice.trigger: A budget owner submits an appraisal request with the required scope, quotes and operating assumptions.
steps: Validate request completeness and extract quote terms with source references, flagging uncertain amounts or conditions.
Retrieve approved AFAS cost data and agency exports; reconcile periods, site mappings and potential duplicate costs.
Run a versioned deterministic model using approved discount rates, tax treatment and financing conventions.
Calculate relevant alternatives and sensitivities, separating cash savings, released capacity and service benefits.
Draft the appraisal pack from calculated outputs and route it for analyst review.
After the investment decision, record approved assumptions and schedule a comparison of expected and actual benefits.
in_practice.human_gate: The analyst verifies extracted terms and the model; the site owner confirms operating assumptions. The Finance Director approves the decision, with HR and OR processes completed where applicable. Funding commitments and bank transactions require their existing approvals.
systems: AFAS Profit extract or configured GetConnector
Excel with a tested appraisal template
Rabobank statement exports and verified financing documents
Approved LLM service and orchestration workflow, proposed additions
data_needed: Supplier quotes, service scope, exclusions and implementation schedules.
Historical site costs, relevant volumes and cash-payment timing.
Agency hours and invoices with reconciliation identifiers.
HR-approved labour rates and CAO-related cost assumptions.
Approved discount rates, VAT and tax treatment, asset lives and residual values.
Verified financing offers and operational estimates from the site owner.
in_practice.logs_to: A restricted SharePoint appraisal register containing request versions, source documents, reconciliations, model versions, assumptions, approvals and benefit reviews.

evidence.claim: Excel provides Scenario Manager, Goal Seek and Data Tables for comparing financial outcomes under different inputs.
AFAS supports controlled retrieval of defined records through GetConnectors; the required finance fields and permissions still need configuration.
The proposed complete appraisal workflow, 65% human-effort saving and 2.5-times end-to-end speedup are untested at Noordhaven. The current steps are an assumed baseline.

risks: The workflow compares alternatives with different capacity, service levels or contract exclusions.
It counts released employee hours as cash savings while staffing costs remain unchanged, or double-counts agency invoices already in AFAS.
An incorrect residual value, discount rate, VAT treatment or distinction between project and financing cash flows reverses the ranking.

Important investments, credit decisions or organisational changes may require OR advice before a final decision. [SER advice-right guidance](https://www.ser.nl/nl/thema/medezeggenschap/aan-de-slag-met-de-or/rechten/adviesrecht)
Supplier quotes or financing terms are stale, confidential or incomplete; the model must show their dates and unresolved conditions.
research_questions: What proportion of historical requests fits a standard appraisal model, and which exceptions require bespoke work?
Can AFAS and agency costs be reconciled without double-counting, and can operating volumes be supplied with reliable definitions?
On ten historical appraisals, does the workflow reproduce reviewed calculations and flag every decision-changing uncertainty?
Including source collection, review and approval, does the pilot achieve the proposed saving without increasing corrections or weakening investment decisions?

tasks.short: Find practical ways to improve site margins and test whether the savings actually arrive.

today.trigger: A margin shortfall, forecast discussion or site review raises a question about efficiency or profitability.
steps: Review Power BI site results and identify unusual revenue, labour or operating-cost movements.
Gather supporting AFAS detail, agency hours and available operational figures.
Discuss possible causes with site managers and separate accounting timing from operating changes.
Estimate savings, implementation costs and effects on capacity, safety and service.
Recommend a pilot and compare subsequent results with the expected benefit.
systems: Power BI on the nightly AFAS extract
drudgery: Repeating the same site and cost comparisons each month.
Combining three agency exports with inconsistent labels.
Preparing charts for issues that turn out to be posting timing or volume mix.
today.time_sinks: Obtaining operational denominators such as handled volume and productive hours, verifying causes and finding a site owner able to run a pilot.

lenses.faster: Automated comparisons separate volume, rate and mix effects and prepare source-linked issue briefings. The analyst spends less time assembling charts and more time testing explanations with the sites.
lenses.autonomous: After each successful nightly refresh, checks flag material movements and prepare an investigation queue. The analyst decides which signals warrant discussion or a pilot.
lenses.ambitious: Review profitability drivers weekly across all three sites and maintain a register of tested improvements. Feed measured benefits and failed assumptions back into the forecast.
lenses.joy: Remove repeated exports and searches for unexplained variances. Keep the site conversations and experiments that make work easier and improve margins.
lenses.options: For each verified issue, compare several responses, such as changing agency mix, reducing rework, adjusting service pricing or improving equipment use. Show the cost, service and implementation trade-offs.
lenses.altitude: Design an improvement process that distinguishes signals, hypotheses, pilots and realised benefits. Judge the process by forecast accuracy and verified results rather than the number of suggestions.
reach: Prepare operational performance investigations with site managers.
Analyse recurring agency-cost exceptions with accounts payable.
Analyse aggregate workforce-cost drivers with the People Analytics and HRIS Analyst.
Support the Controller's tracking of realised improvement benefits.

tasks.human_edge: Understand why shifts and customers differ, distinguish correlation from a workable cause and earn site managers' trust. People closest to the operation must judge safety, service and implementation feasibility.
tasks.pattern_why: Copilot fits opportunity selection and investigation because financial signals do not establish causes or prove an improvement will work. Deterministic_software handles repeatable comparisons, with an llm_step drafting evidence-based briefings for human challenge.

in_practice.trigger: The nightly AFAS extract passes reconciliation checks, or an analyst requests an investigation.
steps: Validate freshness, reconcile financial totals and distinguish posted costs from approved estimates of unposted agency costs.
Join aggregate site costs to approved operational figures and agency hours, flagging missing denominators.
Run materiality and variance checks by site and comparable activity, allowing for seasonality and customer mix.
Draft a briefing containing the signal, supporting records, competing explanations and questions for the site owner.
Have the analyst and site owner choose a pilot with a baseline, success measure and safety and service limits.
Track actual benefits and update the forecast only after review of the evidence.
in_practice.human_gate: The analyst validates the evidence and the site owner approves the pilot. Finance approves forecast changes; HR reviews workforce implications and applicable CAO, reintegration and OR requirements before implementation.
systems: Approved LLM service and scheduled analysis workflow, proposed additions
data_needed: Site-level revenue and costs with posting periods and reconciliation totals.
Agency hours, rates, invoices and approved accrual estimates.
Handled volumes, productive hours, service failures and rework figures supplied by operations; their source systems are not specified.
Customer and activity mix, seasonal patterns and comparable historical periods.
HR-approved aggregate labour costs and planning constraints.
Pilot baselines, implementation costs, accountable owners and actual benefit measurements.
in_practice.logs_to: A restricted SharePoint improvement register recording data freshness, triggered checks, evidence, rejected hypotheses, pilot approvals, measured benefits and forecast changes.

evidence.claim: Power BI can detect anomalies in supported time-series line charts and provide statistical explanations; these are investigation aids rather than proof of causation.
Automated variance comparisons and source-linked briefings can plausibly reduce preparation work, while operational validation remains human work.

The proposed scheduled investigation workflow is custom work, not an established capability of Noordhaven's current setup. The assumed baseline, 35% effort saving and 1.4-times end-to-end speedup require a pilot.

risks: Nightly financial data and late agency invoices generate misleading alerts or conceal current operating problems.
Missing volume, service or activity-mix data makes comparisons between Rotterdam, Tilburg and Venlo unfair.
An apparent saving transfers work elsewhere, reduces service quality or increases safety risks.

Small groups remain identifiable despite aggregation. Use necessary aggregate workforce data, suppress small groups and exclude medical details from analysis. [Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens guidance](https://autoriteitpersoonsgegevens.nl/themas/werk-en-uitkering/zieke-werknemers/regels-voor-werkgevers-bij-zieke-werknemers)

Expanding this workflow into individual worker evaluation or certain task-allocation decisions requires a separate EU AI Act classification assessment. [European Commission AI Act guidance](https://digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/faqs/navigating-ai-act)

Financial savings proposals must respect applicable CAOs and reintegration obligations under Wet verbetering poortwachter. [UWV reintegration guidance](https://www.uwv.nl/nl/ervaringsverhalen/3-praktische-tips-wet-verbetering-poortwachter)
research_questions: Can each site supply comparable volume, productive-hour, service and rework measures, or would financial comparisons be misleading?
In a historical replay, what proportion of material alerts reflects a verified operating issue rather than posting timing, seasonality or mix?
Do pilot benefits remain after implementation costs, transferred work and service effects are included?
Does the process reduce analyst investigation time and improve forecast accuracy enough to justify maintaining the additional data and checks?

role.altitude: Become the owner of Noordhaven's planning assumptions, appraisal methods and evidence for forecast changes. Spend more time challenging business drivers and verifying benefits with site managers.
reach: Controller: maintain consistent planning assumptions and track investment benefits.
Finance Director: prepare decision packs and financing sensitivities.
Accounts payable Bookkeeper: analyse recurring agency-cost and supplier-cost exceptions.
People Analytics and HRIS Analyst: connect aggregate workforce drivers to financial forecasts.
Site operations: design improvement pilots and measure their financial and service effects.
role.ceiling_note: These three tasks cover 268.4 hours per FTE annually, about 16.8% of the role. The proposed effort savings total about 125 hours per FTE, or 250 hours across two analysts: roughly EUR 20,000 of annual capacity at EUR 80/hour before setup and maintenance costs, not guaranteed cash savings. End-to-end speedups are separate hypotheses that allow for review delays. Approval waits, missing operational data and implementation work limit gains; this analysis does not establish a reduction in month-close days or justify removing a position.
skills_to_grow: Build and test deterministic financial models with reconciliations and traceable assumptions.
Define comparable operational and workforce-cost measures across sites.
Evaluate AI document extraction and require source evidence for material claims.
Design pilots that distinguish cash savings, released capacity and displaced costs.
Challenge site assumptions and explain uncertainty clearly to decision makers.
Work with HR on CAO constraints, workforce-data privacy and relevant OR processes.
role.ambitious_version: Maintain a weekly view of the drivers behind each site's forecast, with approved assumptions, reusable appraisals and measured improvement benefits. Give the Finance Director a forecast that shows what changed, why, who owns the assumption and what evidence supports it, while helping sites test practical ways to improve margins.
